COMMON QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Can you support an existing team?+

Yes. The scope can focus on improving current processes or addressing a defined requirement.

Is this recruitment?+

The offering described here focuses on HR administration, payroll setup, and employee compliance support. Recruitment would require a separately confirmed scope.

How is employee information handled?+

Required access, confidentiality, responsibilities, and data handling arrangements must be agreed before work begins.
